description: Ex-Varig DC-3 (c/n 7333) displayed on the forecourt of Carajás airport; credited as the first aircraft to land in the Carajás region and retired with about 43,000 hours. Listed as a municipal tourist attraction by the Prefeitura de Parauapebas and reported in place in a Feb 2026 survivors compilation.
aliases: DC3; C-47; C47; Dakota; Skytrain; c/n 7333; Varig
